title: Weak global solvability of a doubly degenerate parabolic-elliptic nutrient taxis system
summary: This work studies the following doubly degenerate parabolic-elliptic nutrient taxis system $$ \begin{cases} u_t = (uvu_x)_x -(u^2 vv_x)_x + uv, \\[1.5 ex] \hspace{0.2 cm}0 = v_{xx} - uv + f(x,t), \end{cases} $$ in a bounded interval $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}$, under no-flux boundary conditions and nonnegative initial value $u(x,0) = u_0(x) \geq 0$, where $f(x,t) \geq 0$ is known external supply of the nutrient.
